data.title: SvelteKit Auto OpenAPI
data.subtitle: Automatic API Documentation Library
data.description: A developer library that automatically generates OpenAPI schemas and interactive documentation from SvelteKit server routes with full TypeScript type inference.
data.full_description: SvelteKit Auto OpenAPI eliminates the need for manual API documentation by inferring OpenAPI schemas directly from SvelteKit +server.ts files. It provides runtime validation, interactive Scalar-powered docs, and real-time updates during development — all with minimal configuration and full TypeScript support.
data.tags:
SvelteKit
TypeScript
OpenAPI
Scalar
Developer Tools
data.features:
Automatic schema inference from SvelteKit routes
Interactive Scalar API documentation
Runtime request and response validation
Real-time documentation updates in development
